h1: Browser extension build, from idea to store submission
overview: We build your extension on Manifest V3 so it runs in Chrome and Edge. You describe what it should do, we agree a short feature list in writing, then we write the code, design the popup and settings, and test it on real pages. We prepare the store package, the privacy wording and the screenshots you need to submit. You receive the full source code and a short handover note.

faq: Do I need a developer account first?

You need a Chrome Web Store developer account to publish, which carries a small one-time fee paid to Google. We can guide you through setup, and we submit from your account if you add us as a collaborator.
Will it work in browsers other than Chrome?
Manifest V3 extensions run in Chrome and Edge with little change. Firefox and Safari need extra packaging, so ask us and we quote that part separately in writing before we start.
Yes. You receive the complete source code and a build guide, and the extension lives in your own account. We keep no hidden access once the order is closed.
Do you promise the store will approve it?

No one can promise that. We build to the Chrome Web Store rules, keep permissions minimal and explain them plainly, which gives the review the best chance. If a reviewer asks for changes, we help fix them.
